question: Which of the following countries hosted the ACC Under-19 Asia Cup cricket in the year 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UAE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The ACC Under-19 Asia Cup 2023 was hosted by the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**.
 
• Matches were played across multiple venues in the UAE, including **Dubai and Sharjah**, known for their world-class cricket facilities.
 
• The tournament is organized by the **Asian Cricket Council (ACC)**, which oversees cricket development in Asia.
 
• The event serves as a platform for young cricketers in Asia to showcase their talent and prepare for future international competitions.
 
• UAE has previously hosted several international and domestic cricket tournaments due to its **neutral venue status and modern infrastructure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Cricket Council (ACC):**

 
 
• The ACC was established in 1983 to promote and develop the game of cricket in Asia.
 
• It organizes regional tournaments such as the Asia Cup and Under-19 Asia Cup.
 
• Member nations include India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Afghanistan, and others.
 
 
 
• **UAE as a Cricketing Hub:**
 
 
• UAE is a preferred venue for hosting international cricket due to its neutral status and excellent facilities.
 
• Stadiums like Dubai International Stadium and Sharjah Cricket Stadium are globally recognized.
 
• UAE has hosted events like the IPL, T20 World Cup, and PSL.
 
 
 
• **Under-19 Asia Cup:**
 
 
• The tournament is a biennial event organized by the ACC.
 
• It provides exposure to young players and acts as a talent pool for national teams.
 
• Past winners include India, Pakistan, and Afghanistan, showcasing the competitive nature of the event.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Youth Cricket:**
 
 
• Youth tournaments like the Under-19 Asia Cup help identify and nurture future cricket stars.
 
• They provide players with international experience at an early stage in their careers.
 
• Such events also strengthen the cricketing ecosystem in participating nations.
